mapper.sql: R.ROOM_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.ADMIN_ID, R.STATUS, R.STARTED_AT, R.WAITING_AT, R.ENDED_AT, M.MEMBER_NAME, M.PHONE, A.ADMIN_NAME
FROM TBL_CHAT_ROOM R JOIN TBL_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = R.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_ADMIN A ON A.ADMIN_ID = R.ADMIN_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE R.ROOM_ID = (SELECT MAX(ROOM_ID) FROM TBL_CHAT_ROOM WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId})
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ROOM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBL_CHAT_ROOM (ROOM_ID, MEMBER_ID, STATUS, WAITING_AT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{memberId}, #{status}, SYSDATENULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_CHAT_ROOM SET STATUS = '02', WAITING_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS = '01'
UPDATE TBL_CHAT_ROOM SET STATUS = '03', ADMIN_ID = NVL(ADMIN_ID, #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}) WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS IN ('01', '02')
UPDATE TBL_CHAT_ROOM SET STATUS = '04', ENDED_AT = SYSDATE, ADMIN_ID = NVL(ADMIN_ID, #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}) WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS != '04'

UPDATE TBL_CHAT_ROOM R SET R.STATUS = '04', R.ENDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE R.STATUS IN ('01', '03') AND R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND NVL((SELECT MAX(C.SENT_AT) FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE C WHERE C.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID), R.STARTED_AT) < SYSDATE - #{minutes} / 1440
mapper.select:
SELECT , L.CONTENT AS LAST_CONTENT, L.ATTACHMENT_NAME AS LAST_ATTACHMENT_NAME, L.SENT_AT AS LAST_SENT_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE U WHERE U.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND U.SENDER_TYPE = '01' AND U.IS_READ = 'N') AS UNREAD_COUNT
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROOM_ID, MAX(MESSAGE_ID) AS LAST_ID FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE GROUP BY ROOM_ID) LM ON LM.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE L ON L.MESSAGE_ID = LM.LAST_ID WHERE R.ROOM_ID = (SELECT MAX(Z.ROOM_ID) FROM TBL_CHAT_ROOM Z WHERE Z.MEMBER_ID = R.MEMBER_ID) ORDER BY NVL(L.SENT_AT, R.STARTED_AT) DESC, R.ROOM_ID DESC

SELECT DISTINCT R.MEMBER_ID FROM TBL_CHAT_ROOM R JOIN TBL_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = R.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE C ON C.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE LOWER(M.MEMBER_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{query}) || '%' OR LOWER(C.CONTENT) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{query}) || '%' OR LOWER(C.ATTACHMENT_NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{query}) || '%' OR REPLACE(M.PHONE, '-', '') LIKE '%' || #{digits} || '%'

SELECT R.ROOM_ID, R.MEMBER_ID, R.STATUS, R.WAITING_AT FROM TBL_CHAT_ROOM R WHERE R.STATUS = '02' AND R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND R.WAITING_AT < SYSDATE - #{minutes} / 1440 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE C WHERE C.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND C.SENT_AT >= R.WAITING_AT AND (C.SENDER_TYPE = '03' OR (C.SENDER_TYPE = '02' AND C.CONTENT = #{notice})))
mapper.sql: C.MESSAGE_ID, C.ROOM_ID, C.ADMIN_ID, C.TOPIC_ID, C.SENDER_TYPE, C.MESSAGE_TYPE, C.CONTENT, C.ATTACHMENT_PATH, C.ATTACHMENT_NAME, C.IS_READ, C.SENT_AT, A.ADMIN_NAME, T.TITLE AS TOPIC_TITLE
FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE C LEFT JOIN TBL_ADMIN A ON A.ADMIN_ID = C.ADMIN_ID LEFT JOIN TBL_CHATBOT_TOPIC T ON T.TOPIC_ID = C.TOPIC_ID

SELECT R.MEMBER_ID FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE C JOIN TBL_CHAT_ROOM R ON R.ROOM_ID = C.ROOM_ID WHERE C.MESSAGE_ID = #{messageId}

INSERT INTO TBL_CHAT_SETTING (SETTING_ID, BOT_ENABLED, CONSULT_ENABLED, START_TIME, END_TIME, GREETING, DELAY_MESSAGE, AWAY_MESSAGE, ADMIN_ID) VALUES (#{settingId}, #{botEnabled}, #{consultEnabled}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{greeting}, #{delayMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{awayMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC})
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_CHAT_SETTING SET BOT_ENABLED = #{botEnabled}, CONSULT_ENABLED = #{consultEnabled}, START_TIME = #{startTime}, END_TIME = #{endTime}, GREETING = #{greeting}, DELAY_MESSAGE = #{delayMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AWAY_MESSAGE = #{awayMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, ADMIN_ID = #{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} WHERE SETTING_ID = #{settingId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT V.RESERVATION_ID, V.RESERVATION_NO, V.STATUS, V.MOVE_DATE, V.MOVE_TIME, Q.FROM_ADDRESS, Q.TO_ADDRESS FROM TBL_RESERVATION V JOIN TBL_MOVE_REQUEST Q ON Q.REQUEST_ID = V.REQUEST_ID WHERE Q.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN V.STATUS = '01' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, V.MOVE_DATE DESC, V.RESERVATION_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT Q.QUOTE_ID, Q.QUOTE_NO, Q.STATUS, Q.TOTAL_AMOUNT FROM TBL_QUOTE Q WHERE Q.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} OR Q.REQUEST_ID IN (SELECT REQUEST_ID FROM TBL_MOVE_REQUEST WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) ORDER BY Q.QUOTE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
